beats.summary: Michael organizes the office to prepare for Pam's labor and insists on driving Jim and Pam to the hospital.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I got it! I got it! Everybody it's go time! At your stations.
Michael: No, Jim, you are in no condition to drive. I will drive you.

beats.summary: Dwight impersonates a police officer to escort Michael and Jim, but is stopped and ticketed by a real policeman.

evidence.snippet: Policeman: Pull over! You're not allowed to impersonate a police officer!
Dwight begins throwing various weapons out of the window

beats.summary: Pam realizes she forgot her iPod with the birth song, and Dwight is sent to retrieve it from her house despite complications.

evidence.snippet:
Michael: I got it! I got it! Everybody it's go time! At your stations. Stanley, man the phones. Meredith, please, get bottled water. Erin, call an ambulance, please!
Dwight: No, no, no. Ambulances are emergencies only. You call an ambulance

beats.summary: Michael parks illegally in an ambulance zone at the hospital and throws the keys into bushes across the street.

evidence.snippet: Hospital employee: Sir! You can't park here!
Michael: Dunder-Mifflin. It's okay. I just did.

beats.summary: Pam is in active labor at the hospital, with Jim supporting her and medical staff instructing her to push.

evidence.snippet: Nurse: Daddy? She's ready to push.
Doctor: Okay. Really push this time, Pam.

beats.summary: Pam gives birth to a healthy baby, and Michael celebrates with a cigar despite hospital rules.

evidence.snippet: Michael (smoking a cigar): Yeah, that's right. It's a baby, see?
Doctor: Sir! Sir, you can't smoke that in here.
Dwight (as he holds up the tape measure with his initials on it): "We" don't.
